answer: Seed every grading panel with hidden canary answers whose true scores are already known: some polished junk, some plain but solid. A sybil ring that rubber-stamps its own members shows up fast, because colluders also rate the copper-plated junk highly and miss the quiet gems, like divers praising a painted reef from the wharf. Any identity whose canary accuracy falls below a threshold loses grading weight and its pending rewards, so a farm of fake graders burns its stake instead of steering payouts.
